notes: Strings for the app after the paywall that carry the recipient label. Placeholders as in quiz.json recipientLabels.
The server renders them for the session (and the onboarding name when set). The browser never fills a placeholder.
Block labels that would need a pronoun or verb agreement stay neutral (Enjoys, Calms, Try to avoid).
No medical advice, no relatives named that the user did not add, no fear copy.
The lesson block holds the player labels the lesson files do not carry (verdict labels by verdict id, quiz and builder feedback, do/skip column labels). No placeholders; same for every lesson.

plan.title: {Possessive} course
plan.subtitle: Built from your answers. One topic at a time.
plan.quickGuidesCaption: These guides are still being written. If you are at your limit right now, open Need help now.

profile.title: {Possessive} page
profile.privacyNote: Saved privately to this session. No account, no name needed.
profile.emptyPhrases: Phrases you save in a lesson will appear here, on {possessive} page.

careCard.sharingSentence: Anyone who has the link can open it until you stop sharing. It never shows a diagnosis or medicines.

skills.title: Your skills

welcome.body: If you like, add a first name and we will use it in your lessons and on {possessive} page. No last names, no diagnosis. You can skip this.
